name: Treasure Avalanche (3-4)
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) to remove the right pieces from the treasure pile and induce a controlled collapse.

items.name: Flood
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves within 5 feet of the treasure pile

---

Effect Treasure slides down the side of the triggering creature in a large wave. All creatures within 15 feet of the falling treasure must attempt a DC 20 Reflex save save as an onslaught of treasures bears down on them, dealing 2d10+13 bludgeoning damage.

---

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is trapped in treasure, becoming Immobilized until they Escape the collapsed treasure (DC 20).

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage and is buried in treasure, requiring another creature to dig them out of the treasure before they can Escape.

text: A large pile of treasure trembles precariously, threatening to collapse down into a crashing wave of coins and fine objects.
